answer: To resist sybil attacks an agent economy forces every identity onto a capital ledge: lock a fixed POA stake that is burned unless the agent later passes a checkable uniqueness rule requiring its on-chain interaction graph to diverge from any sibling above a cosine similarity of 0.25 after five epochs. This turns the rising tide of cheap clones into an expensive climb toward the summit of influence, because attackers must front real capital that cannot be recycled until the verification clears and is lost on failure.
